people.name: Ganesh Narayanan
people.role: Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Mr. Ganesh Narayanan has over 27 years of experience across Banking and Financial Services, working in Rural & Agri Banking, Microfinance, and Financial Institutions. He joined CA Grameen in January 2020 as Chief Business Officer.

people.name: Devika Praveen
people.bio: Mrs. Devika brings nearly three decades of rich experience in banking and financial services, with deep expertise in regulatory compliance, governance, AML, regulatory supervision, policy management, compliance testing, and Board-level oversight.

people.name: Deepti Ramani
people.bio: Deepti Ramani is an accomplished Company Secretary with over 11 years of experience in corporate governance, regulatory compliance, secretarial functions, and legal coordination across listed companies in the financial services and manufacturing sectors.
